st platforms require input and output on same port, add support for such constrains

pr_comments:
> st platforms require input and output on same port, add support for such constrains

This is wrong.

`tests/drivers/gpio/gpio_basic_api/` expects test pin 1 and test pin 2 to be on the same port.

With [your PR](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77699) pins used for the test have been moved (from A0/A1 to D2/D3) and on most STM32, D2/D3 pins are not on the same GPIO bank, hence test contraint is no more respected.

issue_context.title: tests: gpio_basic_api: arduino not valid on different gpio controllers
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
test execution **drivers.gpio.2pin_arduino**  fails in kernel panic on some stm32 boards because the overlay selects arduino connector pins on different GPIO controllers


Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - example on the nucleo stm32g474re board (and  many others too)
The testcase selects arduino connector pins  8 & 9   through the arduino.overlay file
```
		out-gpios = <&arduino_header 8 (GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH | GPIO_PUSH_PULL | GPIO_PULL_UP)>;
		in-gpios = <&arduino_header 9 (GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH | GPIO_PUSH_PULL | GPIO_PULL_UP)>;
```

On some stm32 boards, like the nucleo_g474re, the arduino pins 8 & 9 are NOT on the same gpio bank 

pin 8    <8 0 &**gpioa** 10 0>,   /* D2*/
pîn 9    <9 0 &**gpiob** 3 0>,	/* D3 */


So the testcase runs into k_panic(); in the board_setup function:
```
	/* PIN_IN and PIN_OUT must be on same controller. */

	if (in_dev != out_dev) {
		printk("FATAL: output controller %s != input controller %s\n",
		       out_dev->name, in_dev->name);
		k_panic();
	}
```

 - Is this a regression? since the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77699


**To Reproduce**
<!--
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. west build -p auto -b nucleo_g474re tests/drivers/gpio/gpio_basic_api/ -- -DDTC_OVERLAY_FILE=arduino.overlay
2. west flash
3. See error
-->

**Expected behavior**
Test passed or excluded

**Impact**
CI failure

**Logs and console output**
```
FATAL: output controller gpio@48000400 != input controller gpio@48000000                                         
E: r0/a1:  0x00000004  r1/a2:  0x0000000a  r2/a3:  0x00000000                                                    
E: r3/a4:  0x00000004 r12/ip:  0x0800925f r14/lr:  0x080004d5                                                    
E:  xpsr:  0x21000000                                                                                            
E: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0x080004e4                                                             
E: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 4: Kernel panic on CPU 0                                                               
E: Current thread: 0x20000228 (main)                                                                             
E: Halting system  
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

 - OS: ubuntu
 - Toolchain (e.g Zephyr SDK, ...) 0.16.3
 - Commit SHA or Version used :  4c6b1e5a65e752c881183ddb4687fa0231b11cc3
comments:
I think this is ST gpio dedicated issue, it requires the gpio on same bank, right? in this case, there is an customize case with allows you to custom for your boards, like below:
```

  drivers.gpio.2pin_arduino:
    min_flash: 34
    depends_on:
      - gpio
      - arduino_gpio
    filter: dt_compat_enabled("test-gpio-basic-api") and dt_compat_enabled("arduino-header-r3")
    extra_args: "DTC_OVERLAY_FILE=arduino.overlay"
    integration_platforms:
      - frdm_k64f
    platform_exclude:
      # below boards are mikro bus not arduino
      - da14695_dk_usb
      - mimxrt595_evk/mimxrt595s/cm33

  drivers.gpio.2pin_arduino_customized:
    min_flash: 34
    depends_on:
      - gpio
      - arduino_gpio
    filter: dt_compat_enabled("test-gpio-basic-api") and dt_compat_enabled("arduino-header-r3")
    platform_allow:
      - mimxrt595_evk/mimxrt595s/cm33
```
